considerations: Exclude approved tests and shared egress.
Check successful sign-ins and account changes near the same window.
description: Find invalid-password failures across many user accounts from one IP.

evidence.claim: Microsoft reported Storm-3358 using ARTEX around financial-sector intrusions, including fast network probing, password abuse and infrastructure associated with remote access tooling.

expected_output: One row per IP and fifteen-minute window passing the account and failure thresholds.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: Find invalid-password failures across many user accounts from one IP.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Entra Password Spray Across Accounts

1.json:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ResultType == "50126" and isnotempty(UserPrincipalName) and isnotempty(IPAddress)
| summarize Failures = count(), Accounts = dcount(UserPrincipalName), SampleAccounts = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 12), Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 8) by IPAddress, Window = bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where Failures >= 25 and Accounts >= 10
| order by Accounts desc, Failures desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
